llm_condensed_answer:
SUMMARY: Adding SelectSorted to the storage.Querier interface requires every concrete implementor across both prometheus and mimir repos to add the new method, as Go interfaces are satisfied structurally. This affects wrappers, adapters, mocks, and decorators, with most implementations delegating to existing Select with sortSeries=true.

FILES:
- prometheus/storage/interface.go — Defines Querier interface and MockQuerier; SelectSorted must be added here
- prometheus/storage/noop.go — noopQuerier implements Querier; needs SelectSorted stub
- prometheus/storage/merge.go — querierAdapter implements Querier; needs SelectSorted delegating to genericQuerier
- prometheus/storage/secondary.go — secondaryQuerier wraps genericQuerier; needs SelectSorted with sortSeries=true
- prometheus/storage/generic.go — querierAdapter.Select is concrete Querier method; needs SelectSorted
- prometheus/tsdb/querier.go — blockQuerier implements Querier; needs SelectSorted calling selectSeriesSet with sortSeries=true
- prometheus/tsdb/ooo_head_read.go — HeadAndOOOQuerier implements Querier; needs SelectSorted calling selectSeriesSet with sortSeries=true
- prometheus/storage/remote/read.go — remote read querier implements Querier; needs SelectSorted delegating to Select
- prometheus/web/api/testhelpers/mocks.go — FakeQuerier implements Querier; needs SelectSorted stub
- mimir/pkg/storage/lazyquery/lazyquery.go — LazyQuerier implements Querier; needs SelectSorted with async handling
- mimir/pkg/querier/blocks_store_queryable.go — blocksStoreQuerier implements Querier; needs SelectSorted calling selectSorted
- mimir/pkg/querier/distributor_queryable.go — distributorQuerier implements Querier; needs SelectSorted delegating to existing logic
- mimir/pkg/querier/tenantfederation/merge_queryable.go — mergeQuerier implements Querier; needs SelectSorted delegating to Select
- mimir/pkg/frontend/querymiddleware/sharded_queryable.go — shardedQuerier implements Querier; needs SelectSorted delegating to Select
- mimir/pkg/querier/memory_tracking_queryable.go — memoryTrackingQuerier implements Querier; needs SelectSorted wrapping inner SelectSorted
- mimir/pkg/querier/querier.go — multiQuerier and chunkQuerier implement Querier; both need SelectSorted

arguments.query: storage Querier interface Select LabelValues LabelNames
